==Biography==

== Trivia ==
* Nicknamed the "军师", which means "military adviser" or "tactician" in Chinese, as it is said that he comes up with the multiple effective strategies that [[OMG]] uses.
* Was previously engaged to a girl named "Lin" hence his name "LoveLin" and subsequent name change after the breakup
* Formerly played support in the team, and was known as one of the 2 "god supports" in China along with [[Team WE]]'s [[FZZF]].
* Was called "China's answer to [[Madlife]]" by Riot Games during the Season 3 World Championships.
* Moved to jungle position, swapping with [[bigpomelo]].
* Known for his {{ci|Lee Sin}} and {{ci|Aatrox}}.
* Known for an extremely unique jungle style, blending early game hyper aggression while simultaneously supporting the team with vision control with early Oracles Elixirs and global pressure.
* Considered one of the best junglers and supports of China.
* Known for being a pioneer in the Chinese scene for emerging junglers such as {{ci|Aatrox}}, while also using unconventional junglers such as {{ci|Yorick}} to great effectiveness, to the point of it being banned against him consistently.
* CEO of his company '''ESI创投基金'''<ref>[http://lol.shandian.biz/344.html OMG灵药退役后成立ESI创投基金坐当CEO，老婆徐可成合伙人无状态拒绝出席] lol.shandian.biz</ref>.
* Hold rank 1 in ''League of Legends: Wild Rift'' for most of season 1 in China.<ref>[https://weibo.com/yinle007?is_all=1#_rnd1609262364253 LoveLing's Weibo Post] weibo.com</ref>
{{PlayerStatsTrivia}}
